run_negative_http2_test: run the negative HTTP/2 client test with a specified test case like goaway or ping
test_goaway_handling: test the gRPC client's handling of GOAWAY frames by sending two sequential unary calls
test_rst_stream_scenarios: test RST_STREAM error handling for after header, during data, and after data scenarios
test_max_streams: test MAX_STREAMS flow control by sending 15 concurrent unary calls to the gRPC server
validate_grpc_status: validate gRPC response status codes and details against expected INTERNAL error codes
